evidence: The paper develops random forest models to predict HCAb binding affinity, stating: "Random forest models trained on Log10(KD) for HCAb binding to SARS-CoV-2 variant RBDs (Beta, Gamma, Delta, Lambda, & Mu variants) were generated and used to predict HCAb binding efficacy on novel variants." However, the entire text contains zero mentions of "importance" or feature-importance concepts. Model evaluation focuses exclusively on prediction accuracy (RMSE, correlation, Q²), and conclusions derive from experimental validation and structural analysis rather than feature importance interpretation.
